final_candidates.decision_summary: N501Y is the best-documented ACE2-affinity-enhancing RBD substitution, arising independently in Alpha/Beta/Gamma/Omicron lineages. WT residue at position 171 is N, matching N501 numbering.
N439K is a naturally circulating substitution reported to modestly increase human ACE2 binding affinity. WT N at position 107 matches N439.
S477N appeared in circulating and in-vitro evolved lineages with modest ACE2 affinity gains. WT S at position 147 matches S477.

stop_reason.detail: Phenotype and structure tools are not applicable for this task; remaining evidence tools (MSA/PLM) would not materially change the literature-backed Top-3 ranking.
